title: Amount of an Out-of-Area Repair Reimbursement — Road Hazard Protection
content:
**Repair part.** The repair part of a Road Hazard Protection out-of-area repair reimbursement is the plan's out-of-area repair cap, the figure on the plan's out-of-area reimbursement schedule.

**Reimbursement.** The out-of-area repair reimbursement is the repair part, held at 0.00 or more, plus every allowance and uplift that applies to it; only that sum is rounded half up to the cent, it is never below 0.00, and it is paid to the tender the certificate was bought with.

| Line | Quantity |
|---|---|
| A | repair part: the plan's out-of-area repair cap, held at 0.00 or more |
| B | allowances and uplifts that apply |
| C | reimbursement: A plus B, rounded half up to the cent, never below 0.00 |

**Hypothetical example.** On a plan whose out-of-area repair cap is 30.00 and with no allowance or uplift applying, a repair receipt covering that reimbursement is reimbursed 30.00, paid to the tender the certificate was bought with — a certificate bought on a bank credit card is reimbursed to that card.
